criteria.statement: A valid accepted policy survives backend restart/image replacement while its canonical relay is unavailable.
A valid event available only from a secondary eligible relay, including delivery after EOSE inside the drain, is promoted deterministically.

Zero-event EOSE, outage, AUTH failure, timeout, retrieval/promotion error, malformed payload, invalid signature, wrong author/schema/tags, older/equal losing event, and future timestamp never erase a valid head.
An explicitly service-signed empty policy is valid; absence never synthesizes empty policy.
The signer-first ContextVM get response exposes projection availability, event ID, author, hash, source relay, timestamps, last-sync, and freshness without a config-default or unsigned REST fallback.
